## JARVIS Briefing v1 - every morning at 6:00 (Toronto) on Telegram
Reads JARVIS memory (reports, approvals waiting, decisions, problems), the free AI phrases it (facts only), then sends a short text and a voice message. To change the time: open *Every day 6:00* and edit the hour.
Credentials: **OmniRoute** in *AI wording*; **JARVIS Telegram** in *Send briefing* and *Send voice*. Save, then Publish. Settings -> Error workflow -> JARVIS Alerts v1.
